## Problem

What are you trying to do, or what bottleneck are you trying to prove/fix?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. Keep it aligned with the project's scope — a small,
honest scaling testbed where optimizations are earned by a reproduced failure.

## Reproduced failure (for performance changes)

How would the bottleneck be reproduced with k6? Which `make load-*` target or new
scenario, and what does the before/after look like?

## Scope check

- [ ] This fits the scaling-testbed scope (not app-specific business logic)
- [ ] I've checked the [roadmap](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) and open issues
